sections.description: ClickMasters builds AI specifically for San Diego's world-class biotech, defense, telecom, and healthcare sectors.

items.title: Biotechnology (San Diego's Defining Industry)
items.description: San Diego's Torrey Pines biotech cluster rivals Boston's Kendall Square for global significance. Illumina, Pfizer (La Jolla site), Thermo Fisher, Vividion Therapeutics, Gossamer Bio, and hundreds of clinical-stage biotech companies. Drug discovery AI: ML for small molecule property prediction, ADMET modeling, hit-to-lead optimization, and generative molecular design. Genomics and diagnostics: next-generation sequencing data analysis ML (San Diego is the home of Illumina, which sequenced a large fraction of the world's genome data), multiomics integration, and diagnostic assay optimization. Clinical trial AI: patient stratification, site selection optimization, protocol deviation prediction, and real-time efficacy signal detection. Pharmaceutical manufacturing AI: process analytical technology (PAT) AI for biopharmaceutical manufacturing quality prediction. *All San Diego biotech AI delivered with HIPAA compliance where PHI is involved and FDA SaMD awareness for clinical-facing AI.*
items.label: Biotech

items.title: Defense and Aerospace Technology
items.description: SAIC (San Diego HQ), General Dynamics IT (major San Diego presence), Northrop Grumman, Leidos, and the extraordinary concentration of defense technology companies in the San Diego area. ClickMasters handles commercial AI for defense-adjacent organizations; classified and ITAR-controlled work is outside our scope. Commercial defense AI applications: supply chain analytics, facilities management AI, HR analytics, and enterprise software AI for defense technology companies' commercial operations.
items.label: Defense Tech

ClickMasters designs clinical AI with FDA SaMD awareness, distinguishing between general wellness tools (lower regulatory burden) and software that supports clinical decision-making (potential SaMD classification).
